_readme: One licence record for every file that ships from public/. Read by tools/licence-audit.mjs. Add a record IN THE SAME COMMIT as any new file under public/. Categories: credited (third-party, must have a docs/CREDITS.md row: creditsKey must appear there), self-made (builder = the script that makes it), tripo (plan must be confirmed by the owner), flag (not allowed, must be replaced). match = paths, * matches any characters except /.

worthKnowing: The panchayat flag is the Indian national flag, drawn by our own code (src/props.js) and inside panchayat_v2.glb. Showing it in the village is normal; keep it off the store page, box art, logo and ads unless your lawyer says it is fine.

The old saloon car is drawn by our code in the shape of a 1960s Ambassador, with no name or badge; the jeep is generic with blank plates. No real brand name, logo or wordmark appears anywhere (the code has a standing "no brands" rule).

The people's extra moves (gestures) are inside the character files; no outside animation file is in the repo. If any move was downloaded from somewhere other than Tripo (for example Mixamo), tell the lead so it can be recorded.
Sounds are shipped but switched off until final polish; all 19 are CC0 and credited.
